test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, D, E, F, G, H and W, are sitting in a row facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between W and D. G sits to the immediate left of D. No one sits to the right of H. Only two people sit between H and G. E sits to the immediate left of G. How many people sit between F and E?
solution:
**Given: **Six people, D, E, F, G, H and W, are sitting in a row facing north(but not necessarily in the same order).

No one sits to the right of H. Only two people sit between H and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8489c25b173b7b2e44aa5f88eb9ac6a4d575239e3149ad1f6a2cb57f705051e3.png] 

Only two people sit between W and D. G sits to the immediate left of D. E sits to the immediate left of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad9415bcfa34603bfc74a54e260680d042a0c85c8bdc20765d8d969551700493.png] 

Thus, Only two people sit between F and E.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
